subject: English
question_text: Complete the following passage using suitable connectors:
stimulus: Our environment is getting polluted in many ways. (a) — our air is being polluted by smoke from vehicles, household wastes, industrial wastes, smoke from burning fuels and so on. (b) — water is being polluted for using insanitary latrines, for using pesticides in croplands, for industrial wastes (c) — for many other reasons. Another form of pollution is sound pollution. (d) — this pollution occurs because of our unconsciousness. (e) — we all should be conscious of the side effects of any kind of pollution and act accordingly to lead a healthier and happier life.
guide_solution: Change the narrative style: The teacher asked Raju angrily why he had been absent from the class for a long time when his exam was knocking at the door. Raju apologized and promised that he would never be irregular again, explaining that he had actually been suffering from Dengue fever. The teacher then advised him to be regular from then on.

subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: Our environment is getting polluted in many ways. (a) — our air is being polluted by smoke from vehicles, household wastes, industrial wastes, smoke from burning fuels and so on. (b) —, water is being polluted for using insanitary latrines, for using pesticides in croplands, for industrial wastes (c) — for many other reasons. Another form of pollution is sound pollution. (d) —, this pollution occurs because of our unconsciousness. (e) —, we all should be conscious of the side effects of any kind of pollution and act accordingly to lead a healthier and happier life.
guide_solution: (a) For example/For instance; (b) Similarly; (c) and; (d) Actually/In fact; (e) So/Therefore/Hence/That's why.
